title: Are The FAANG Stocks For The Future? Part IV - Today's Editors' Picks | Seeking Alpha
text:
If you had invested $100 in each of the five FAANG stocks (Facebook (NASDAQ: FB ), Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ), Netflix (NASDAQ: NFLX ), Google (NASDAQ: GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL )) on May 18, 2012, your portfolio would be worth over $5,000 today (over a 900% return). But past results don’t indicate much about the future and our contributors have expressed key caveats when considering an investment in FAANG, including overexposure (if invested in index funds), expensive valuation, and high volatility that doesn’t fit into one’s strategy. What are your thoughts on FAANG? Which FAANG stocks are likely to outperform others? Together, are they an attractive investment? If so, for what type of investor?
Our contributors keep their ears to the ground and their eyes on the screen looking for profitable opportunities in the marketplace. Today, contributors Jennifer Warren , Gary Gordon , Avi Gilburt , and BDC Buzz bring us some of the best ideas. Let us know which is your favorite in the comment section below.
Here are today’s Editors’ Picks:
Mazal Tov on your gains (SA For FAs) Why you should question the unicorns (Gary Gordon) The United States Oil ETF (Jennifer Warren) Next week's news (Avi Gilburt) Investing stories to be told (Daniel Shvartsman) TCG BDC Inc (BDC Buzz) Chart of the day: Credit & The Market
Comment of the day, by contributor Wall Street Wizard
I agree 100%. AMZN, TSLA and a few others are wildly overvalued.
But the majority of the market is actually fairly valued, if not slightly overvalued, according to inflation adjusted P/E ratios. Moreover, tech companies like AAPL, FB, & GOOGL in particular are valued well within their growth. There are plenty of anxious Chicken Littles out there, as well as sanguine Pollyanna's, but the reality is that this market can go much higher. Furthermore, investors will be kicking themselves in 20-30 years for not investing in AAPL & GOOGL today. Even though they have seen phenomenal growth thus far, their real story and the tech revolution is only beginning. Also you could actually make the case that these are the new consumer staple stocks. Even if I were to accept the chicken little bear is here view, you can't go wrong with AAPL & GOOGL. They are a great investment in any market.
